Subject: Supplier portal invite failure when using SSO

Hi Karthik,

We received the supplier portal invite this morning but when our vendor rep tries to accept and "Login with SSO" the flow throws an error: "Invalid scoped token" and lands back on the login page. Screenshot attached (acme-invite-screenshot.png).

This blocks our ability to receive POs for the North America BU — we need the supplier profile fully activated by EOD if possible.

What I tried so far:
- Confirmed link hasn't expired (invite was issued ~30 minutes ago)
- Cleared cookies and retried in incognito
- Tried both Google and our corporate SSO (Okta) — same result

Can you confirm whether the invite token scope and relay-state are being set correctly? If it's easier, we can provide logs or a replay trace.

Thanks,
Lucas
Lucas Moreno
Head of Procurement Ops
Acme Components

Hi Lucas — thanks for the report and the screenshot. Sorry for the trouble, we'll get this sorted quickly.

Quick notes and immediate asks so we can troubleshoot: 
- Can you forward the full redirect URL you see in the browser when the error occurs (the URL after the SSO redirect)?
- If possible, send a timestamp (UTC) for a failed attempt — we'll correlate with our traces.
- Please confirm the vendor's legal entity name and tax ID (we may be able to manually activate their profile while we debug the token issue).

Temporary mitigation: we can do a manual activation of the supplier profile and issue a fresh invite with an expanded token TTL and explicit scope for SSO. That will require approvals from Procurement (CC'd).

I've asked Marissa to own the manual activation and follow the procurement checklist. Ben — can you prepare a short DocuSign SOW link for them so they can complete onboarding if the portal flow stays flaky?

I'll start pulling the trace for the invite token (trace id will follow in a separate note).

Best,
Karthik Iyer

Hi Lucas — we have a short plan and next steps. Apologies again for the interruption.

What we did: 
- Correlated your failed attempt (2026-12-09T11:44:58Z) with our invite issuance trace (trace-20261209-1145). We saw the invite token generated with scope=invite:accept and TTL=15m. The Okta redirect appended relayState params which caused the portal to validate a different expected redirect URL and reject the token.

Immediate workaround (actioned):
- Manually activated the supplier profile for Acme Components LLC so procurement can issue POs.
- Reissued an invite with TTL=2h and explicit SSO scope to tolerate relayState additions. New invite sent to marie.torres@acme-components.com.
- Uploaded onboarding documents to the account and shared DocuSign SOW link for signature.

Attachments (sent to your team):
- onboarding-checklist.xlsx (supplier onboarding checklist we completed)
- docusign-acme-sow.pdf (DocuSign package: https://docusign.com/s/ABC-123)

Next steps for Acme (please confirm):
- Marie should click the new invite and complete the DocuSign items; if she still sees an error, send us the browser URL and timestamp and we'll escalate to engineering immediately.
- Procurement to confirm PO routing and notify us once the first PO has been submitted so we can verify end-to-end.

Ben — thanks for generating the short SOW package and the DocuSign link. Lucas — please confirm when Marie receives the invite so we can close this out.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Lead, Supplier Integrations
Redwood Inference
